note: Oglethorpe County's own ArcGIS Online account (services1.arcgis.com/IX9GvidKl201KteW) hosts parcel layers (Oglethorpe_Parcels_view, Tax_Parcels, oglethorpe_county), but every one returns 'Token Required' to anonymous requests. The county's public parcel viewer is qPublic (Schneider), which returns a Cloudflare 403 and exposes no REST endpoint. Searches found only commercial vendors (Regrid, DynamoSpatial, ReportAllUSA), not county-published data. Access requires a token/login, so the county is recorded as unavailable.
